loadRemoteNotesFailed: Failed to load remote notes. Check the target connection settings.
targetTokenSecret1Description: Store the API token under Settings → Secrets and variables, then enter the secret name here
targetTokenSecret2Description: Store the API token under Settings → Secrets and variables, then enter the secret name here
targetSourceDescription: Select the target SiYuan server used by connection, pairing, browsing, and transfer actions
transferModeDescription: Exact-ID mirror preserves paths and internal IDs for an explicitly paired target; one-time copy imports a native archive with new IDs
validateConnectionDescription: Check the active target version, authentication, and notebook read access
pairActiveTargetDescription: Create and verify explicit mirror lineage between this local workspace and the active target. Pairing is never automatic.
adoptFullCloneDescription: Explicit recovery for a destination created by a full workspace clone. Archives copied lineage, rotates only the chosen destination identity, and does not pair automatically.
adoptFullCloneConfirm: This permanently changes the chosen destination workspace identity and clears its active copied lineage after archiving it. Use only when the active target is a confirmed full clone of this local workspace. Continue?
adoptFullClonePrompt: Type ADOPT_FULL_CLONE_DESTINATION exactly to confirm rotating the active target identity.
adoptFullCloneConfirmationMismatch: Full-clone adoption cancelled because the confirmation text did not match.
adoptFullCloneSucceeded: Destination clone identity rotated. Copied lineage archive: ${archivePath}. Pair explicitly when ready.
adoptFullCloneFailed: Failed to adopt the full-clone destination
verifyPairingDescription: Read lineage metadata from both workspaces and refresh the pairing status without transferring data
resetPairingDescription: Remove peer lineage records only when neither side has a pending operation. Pending operations require recovery first; workspace identities remain.
pairingStatusDescription: Current lineage state for the local workspace and active target
pairingVerified: The active target pairing is valid
pairingResetSucceeded: The active target pairing was reset
pendingRecoveryRequired: Pairing reset is blocked because one or both lineage records contain a pending mirror operation. Recover or complete a verified rollback first; do not erase the safety record.
resetPairingConfirm: Reset mirror lineage between this local workspace and the active target? Exact-ID mirror transfers will be blocked until the two workspaces are paired again.
pairingRequired: Exact-ID mirror is blocked. Open plugin settings, pair or verify the active target, and resolve: ${reasons}
dockPairingRequired: Exact-ID pull is disabled. Open plugin settings and pair or verify this active target; resolve any pending or mismatch reason shown above.
transferAllDescription: Native full-workspace archive import for an empty or disposable target; this action does not pair workspaces or perform exact mirroring
pullAllDescription: Native full-workspace archive import into the local workspace for a one-time migration; this action does not pair workspaces
enableLoggingDescription: Reserved setting for diagnostic console output
allowInsecureHttpDescription: Enable only on a trusted LAN; HTTP exposes API tokens, notes, and workspace archives in transit
configureTargetFirst: Configure the active target server URL first
connectionFailed: Failed to connect to the active target server
legacyTokenWarning: A legacy plaintext token was found. Create a Secret under SiYuan Settings → Secrets and variables and enter its name in the plugin settings. The old value is removed after successful validation.
transferCurrentNoteTree: Push current note and all sub-notes
transferFailedPartial: Full transfer failed; the destination may contain partially imported data
pullFailedPartial: Full pull failed; the local workspace may contain partially imported data
fullTransferWarning: Full transfer uses SiYuan's native all-data archive, independently of the selected note transfer mode. It imports all local data into the target and may overwrite or mix existing data. It does not create mirror pairing. Confirm matching SiYuan versions, backups, and an empty or disposable destination. Continue?
fullPullWarning: Full pull uses SiYuan's native all-data archive, independently of the selected note transfer mode. It imports all target data into this local workspace and may overwrite or mix existing data. It does not create mirror pairing. Confirm matching SiYuan versions, backups, and that this workspace is disposable. Continue?
selectiveTransferContinue: Confirm the information above and continue the transfer?
independentCopyWarningArchive: Independent copy uses SiYuan's native document archive.
independentCopyWarningNewIds: The destination creates new document, block, and attribute-view IDs.
independentCopyWarningExpandedScope: Beyond the selection, the archive can include referenced documents, child documents allowed by source settings, related attribute views, PDF annotations, and supporting assets.
exactMirrorWarningIdentity: Exact-ID mirror keeps the same notebook path and document and ordinary-block IDs.
exactMirrorWarningConflicts: It aborts before writing on lineage, path, title/HPath, ID, asset, or three-way content conflicts.
exactMirrorWarningUnsupported: Attribute views, encrypted notebooks, and document renames or moves are not currently supported.
exactMirrorWarningRollback: Failure recovery uses best-effort verified rollback rather than a SiYuan-provided atomic transaction.
fileTreeReloadWarning: Data was imported, but the file tree could not refresh automatically; refresh or restart SiYuan manually
residualAssetCleanup: Residual asset paths retained for manual cleanup
resetPairingPendingConfirm: A pending mirror operation exists on one or both workspaces. Force reset discards that safety record (an archive copy is kept in both plugin data folders), and any partially applied mirror writes are left as they are. Verify the destination workspace before pairing again. Force reset now?
firstSyncConflictConfirm: First-sync conflict: the destination document already exists with different content and no sync baseline exists (for example after re-pairing or an interrupted transfer). Overwrite the destination with the LOCAL version and record it as the sync baseline? The destination's current content for the affected document(s) will be replaced and cannot be recovered from the plugin.
createAndMapNotebook: Create and map notebook on target
targetNotebookNameRequired: Target notebook name cannot be empty
notebookMappedSucceeded: Created and mapped notebook on target: ${name} (${id})
sectionTargetServersDesc: Configure and test remote SiYuan instances for transfer and sync
sectionSyncTransferDesc: Manage workspace pairing, continuous mirror, notebook mappings, and migration tools
fullMigrationDesc: Native all-data archive import and export for initial migration or full-clone setups. Use with caution.
mirrorSubgroupDesc: Preserve identical paths and IDs across workspaces with bilateral notebook mappings
modeSubgroupDesc: Default behavior for toolbar and dock note transfers
